name: The Perfect Poison
label: Quest
description: The Perfect Poison: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.
Lord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

There are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, adventurer. Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This ain't no smash and grab job, friend. You're gonna need to bring friends.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! Take your pick!
